name: crepe-student
description: Crepe segmentation on the raw hotplate camera frame, distilled from SAM 3 masks; fold state from the mask area relative to the run's flat crepe

outputs.name: mask
outputs.meaning: 1 = crepe (argmax of the two class logits)

preprocess.source: raw camera frame (BGR) from the run video, not the corrected view

state_rule.live: maus_export.crepe_student.StudentStateMachine (9-frame vote, empty hold 30 frames, folds only after the flat area is stable for 50 frames)

training.teacher: facebook/sam3, text prompts 'crepe' and 'food', union of instances with score >= 0.4, parts mostly off the SAM 3 plate removed
training.frames: raw check-moment frames (plate_clean, spread, fold1, fold2) from run videos
training.split: sha1(run_id) mod 5 == 0 is test (maus_export.crepe_student.is_test_run); not the chronological split of frames.parquet
training.augmentation: horizontal flip, brightness gain 0.8-1.2 and offset +-0.2
training.trained_outside_git: fold prototype, 2026-10-31; teacher masks and weights kept privately

check_moment_agreement.label: robot check moment (plate_clean=empty, spread=flat, fold1=half, fold2=quarter), passed checks only
check_moment_agreement.caveat: rule thresholds were read off the same frames, including test runs

metrics.leave_one_robot_out_note: not run: needs a retrain per robot; maus-otto has only 6 runs

human_labels.source: reviewed Label Studio exports, 2 sets, frames every 5 s of 5 consecutive runs of one robot; 4 of the 5 runs are student training runs

latency.pi5_estimate_method: single-thread preprocess+model median x 4 (rough Cortex-A76 vs x86 factor, not measured)

known_limits: small fresh batter at the start of spreading is often missed (13 of 30 human 'spreading' frames read as empty) and very small failed spreads are missed
a crepe being pushed off the plate and hands or tools over the plate are not trained
no hole class: holes inside the crepe count as crepe
position and angle are not derived yet
